limitations: The deposit's 'Distal colon' is annotated as organism part 'colon' (UBERON has no 'distal colon' term); the samples are mucus removed from ileum or distal colon explants (material type 'organism part').
Age of the mice is not stated in the paper main text; developmental stage 'not available'.
Biological replicate = order of the sample within its segment × room × food group (1–3). Whether an ileum and a colon sample come from the same mouse is not stated, so no individual is annotated.

Fragment tolerance, reduction reagent and the acetylation position (protein N-terminus assumed, the MaxQuant default) are not stated; the alkylation reagent (iodoacetamide) is inferred from the fixed carbamidomethylation and the PRIDE PTM list.
